_note: Each question is asked of every selected passage as natural language inference hypotheses. 'evidence' gates whether the passage addresses the question; 'options' are the answer choices of the tariff-path question; 'timing' separates claims about a change that has not yet taken effect from descriptions of rates in force or past actions (the revised measure).

china_path.evidence: The text is about U.S. tariffs on goods from China.

options.higher: The text says U.S. tariffs on goods from China are being raised or newly imposed.
options.lower: The text says U.S. tariffs on goods from China are being lowered, paused, or removed.
options.same: The text says U.S. tariffs on goods from China will stay at their current level.

timing.future: The speaker announces, threatens, or plans a new or changed tariff on China that has not yet taken effect.
timing.in_force_or_past: The speaker describes a tariff on China that is already in effect or that was imposed in the past.

broad_path.evidence: The text is about U.S. tariffs on imports from most or all countries.

options.higher: The text says U.S. tariffs on imports from most or all countries are being raised or newly imposed.
options.lower: The text says U.S. tariffs on imports from most or all countries are being lowered, paused, or removed.
options.same: The text says U.S. tariffs on imports from most or all countries will stay at their current level.

timing.future: The speaker announces, threatens, or plans a new or changed tariff on imports from most or all countries that has not yet taken effect.
timing.in_force_or_past: The speaker describes a tariff on imports from most or all countries that is already in effect or that was imposed in the past.
